description: Ship a prebuilt Windows binary through Chocolatey from a Zuke build: a typed choco CLI wrapper, an injection-safe package renderer for a release-hosted zip, local install verification, masked-key publishing and a Windows CI job.

Authenticode signing through SignPath for Zuke builds: submit a signing request (direct upload or GitHub Actions origin), wait for it, download the signed artifact and verify it with signtool. The API token never reaches an error.
